control: Same signed packages and finite observation as v65. Desktop visually confirmed awake before installation; 12 QEMU Control press/release events kept the VM awake.
findings: Keeping the desktop awake restores real DWM draws on the NPU; topology alone did not establish visible display activity.
DWM created its rendering device 58 times. No UMD D3D rejection was recorded for DWM; the existing HRESULT-returning Present path does not log its own failures.
DXGI Present reported device removed (0x887a0005) 56 times. This is not proof of a hardware reset: the underlying failure still requires attribution.
Real desktop source-over scaled linear sampling completed on the NPU. Complete frames still did not reach IddCx.
cleanup: Both devices removed successfully without restarting the VM; physical host drivers unchanged.
next_step: Trace the Present DDI request, validation rejection and runtime callback HRESULT before changing presentation semantics.
